title: Holistic Unlearning Benchmark: A Multi-Faceted Evaluation for Text-to-Image Diffusion Model Unlearning
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the unlearning of specific concepts (Celebrity, Style, IP, and NSFW content) in text-to-image diffusion models. Although the NSFW category (nudity, violence, and disturbing content) relates to general AI safety and content moderation, the benchmark does not contain a component specifically evaluating religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or philosophical ethical/moral frameworks.
